name: run_tests
description: Run the workspace test suite with fixed probes (cargo test / python -m unittest / python -m pytest / npm test). Does NOT accept arbitrary commands. Bounded wait: timeout_secs (default 900, max 900) kills the whole process tree and reports timeout=true. Returns exit code, passed flag, timeout flag, duration, profile_reason and output tails.

profile.description: Force a specific runner; omit to auto-detect (first match wins: cargo > pytest > unittest > npm)

extra.description: Extra args appended to the test command (e.g. a test-name filter). Max 16 items, each <= 200 chars.

timeout_secs.description: Bounded wait in seconds (default 900, max 900). On timeout the whole process tree is killed and timeout=true is reported.
